description_en: Gets the list of node tuple orders submitted by the user
description_zh: 获取用户已提交的节点元组工单列表
name: ListNodeTupleOrders

parameters.help_en:
Filters by order status. If this parameter is not specified, orders in all statuses are returned.

For valid order status values, see the type description below
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态过滤，如未传入此参数，则不限制工单状态。

工单状态取值请参见下方类型说明
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the order was initiated by KPM
parameters.name: is_kpm

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of orders to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的工单数量上限，须大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort query results. Valid values:

CREATED_MILLIS: Sorts by order creation time.

ACCEPTED_MILLIS: Sorts by order approval time
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果的排序字段，可取值为：

CREATED_MILLIS：根据工单发起时间排序。

ACCEPTED_MILLIS：根据工单审批通过时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
This parameter must be used together with the SortingField parameter.

true: Sorts in ascending order.

false: Sorts in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
需配合SortingField字段一起使用。

true：表示升序。

false：表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of node tuple order information that meets the filter criteria
List.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的节点元组工单信息列表

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

CreatedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was submitted, in milliseconds
CreatedMillis.description_zh: 提交此工单的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

FailedCount.description_en: The number of node key issuance failures

IsKpm.description_en:
Indicates whether the order was initiated by KPM.

true: Yes.

false: No
IsKpm.description_zh:
是否是Kpm发起的工单。

true：是。

false：否

OrderState.description_en: The status of the node key application

RequiredCount.description_en: The number of node keys requested

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of node keys successfully issued

TotalCount.description_en: The number of orders that meet the filter criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的工单数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
